about: [O6 critic] the hundred beat (?start=smash.hundred): the frame times round the sedan's blast (rAF deltas), against the second before it.

steps.eval: (() => { const W = window.__ft = { d: [], last: null, blastAt: null }; const t = (now) => { if (W.last != null) W.d.push([+(now - W.last).toFixed(1), G.city && G.city.cars && G.city.cars.some((c) => c.wrecked) ? 1 : 0]); W.last = now; if (W.d.length < 900) requestAnimationFrame(t); }; requestAnimationFrame(t); return 1; })()

(() => { const W = window.__ft; const pre = W.d.filter((x) => !x[1]).map((x) => x[0]), post = W.d.filter((x) => x[1]).map((x) => x[0]); const i = W.d.findIndex((x) => x[1]); const s = (a) => a.length ? { n: a.length, max: Math.max(...a), med: a.slice().sort((p, q) => p - q)[a.length >> 1] } : null; return JSON.stringify({ pre: s(pre.slice(-60)), post: s(post.slice(0, 60)), around: W.d.slice(Math.max(0, i - 4), i + 12).map((x) => x[0]), over: G.stage.smash.stats }); })()
